english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.codeOrQRWor: Code or QR works without setup. Automatic nearby selection needs the small FilterTube helper running on each computer.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.theHelperSh: The helper shows only devices that choose Let this device appear.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.findingADev: Finding a device does not grant permission; both screens must still show the same safety phrase.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.noRulesPINs: No rules, PINs, profile IDs, or private keys are broadcast on the network.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.chooseWheth: Choose whether parent-approved updates need an optional waiting path for another device.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.useSendUpda: Use Send Update for normal parent control.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.addAnOption: Add an optional send path only when both devices cannot be open together.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.protectedPr: Protected profiles still cannot change parent rules from their own surface.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.useThisOnly: Use this only when Send Update is not practical because the verified protected device will open later or away from this parent device.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.defaultPath: Default path: open both devices and use Send Update.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.internetPic: Internet Pickup needs a compatible pickup address. It can hold unreadable waiting updates, not PINs or plaintext rules.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.theProtecte: The protected device still applies only newer signed updates from its saved parent link.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.useCopySetu: Use Copy Setup Command if you want to run the included provider behind your own trusted HTTPS address.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.enterTheTru: Enter the trusted HTTPS address that will hold unreadable parent-approved updates until the verified protected device opens later or away. Leave blank to use Send Update only.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.optionalKey: Optional key for that pickup address. This is not the parent PIN. Leave blank to keep the saved key; enter a single dash to clear it.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.useThisOnly: Use this only when Send Update is not practical and you run a FilterTube-compatible Home Pickup service for verified devices on your home, clinic, or school network.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.homePickupC: Home Pickup can help a verified protected device pick up waiting updates on the same network.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.itIsNotAuto: It is not automatic Wi-Fi discovery; being nearby never grants control.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.theProtecte: The protected device still accepts only newer signed updates from its saved parent link.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.useCopySetu: Use Copy Setup Command if you want to run the included self-hosted pickup provider.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.enterTheHom: Enter the Home Pickup service address only if you run one for verified devices on this family map. This is not device scanning; Send Update remains the normal path.
english.dashboard.sync.providerModal.optionalSer: Optional service key for that Home Pickup service. This is not the parent PIN. Leave blank to keep the saved key; enter a single dash to clear it.
